basics.name: Hugo Enrique Arganda Salazar
basics.summary: Engineering leader with 14+ years across connected vehicles, embedded systems, IoT, cloud platforms, and software delivery. Lead multidisciplinary engineering organizations and own hiring, people development, technical architecture, delivery roadmaps, and execution. Experienced bridging firmware and embedded systems with cloud and application platforms; accountable for architecture across edge-to-cloud telemetry, Android Automotive validation, and OTA and release-management initiatives. Hands-on background in C/C++, Python, Go, JavaScript, Linux, AWS IoT, FleetWise, Greengrass, CI/CD, telemetry, OTA workflows, and distributed edge-to-cloud systems. Improve engineering outcomes through AI-assisted automation and scalable delivery workflows.
